description: This file contains utility functions for verifying the URL resolution of the '/api/users' endpoint within a frontend codebase, primarily used for development-time assertions and debugging.

methods.name: verifyUsersUrlResolution(organizationIdOverride = null)
methods.description: Constructs and logs the expected URL for the '/api/users' endpoint, optionally overriding the organizationId, and performs runtime validation of query parameters.

parameters.name: organizationIdOverride
parameters.description: Optional override for the organization ID used to simulate different organizational contexts.

methods.name: quickUsersResolutionSmoke()
methods.description: Convenience function that calls verifyUsersUrlResolution with a test organization ID ('T0015') to quickly log an example URL resolution for testing purposes.
